title: cmfrt. and Jaheem released a new track "FACELIFT" (feat. Jay Coast)
htmlContent:
cmfrt., Jaheem and Jay Coast's "FACELIFT" is that amazing music that shows what music is all about. They help the listener leave all of their problems on the door, with a sweet sound that you can get away to, as you get engulfed in every element of the record, that displays their artistry to the fullest, as well as their true knack of making hits for the world to jam to.
